last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription topics plus 1 exact replacement topic. The main query set returned 207 unique PubMed PMIDs, 205 fetched article records, and 204 abstracts available for inspection. The exact replacement query for Mediterranean diet, exercise, and weight loss returned 8 PubMed records and confirmed PMID 30389673. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 30219432, 31036412, 32690176, 32951714, 31398841, 39313030, 19386741, 27810310, 31800140, 29393665, 35130547, 32698457, 22743313, 31367691, 40944189, 35889947, 30389673, and 38932663. Seventeen retained references were new to the database; PMID 29393665 was already linked. Eighteen new entries across eighteen qualified topics retain numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects. Green tea, green coffee bean, konjac, yogurt, vinegar, curcumin, and chia topics were linked to existing entries. Saffron, probiotic weight loss, black seed, walnut, and oat beta-glucan topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
